series: Myth or Fact (new-look sample B: dialogue + myth/fact split)

scenes.head: Profit is up. So the bank *will lend?*

lines.say: Myth or fact? If profit is up, the bank will lend.
Profit's up twenty percent. The bank should be easy.
lines.bubble: Profit's up 20%. The bank should be *easy*.

lines.say: Banks are repaid from cash, not profit.
lines.bubble: Banks are repaid from *cash*, not profit.

lines.say: Not when customers take ninety days to pay.
lines.bubble: Not when customers take *90 days* to pay.

scenes.fact: They look at the *cash* that repays the loan.
scenes.src: Our view. Each bank's criteria differ; check your facility letter.

lines.say: In our view, that's a myth.
Banks look at the cash that repays the loan, and how well it covers each payment.
lines.cap: Banks look at the *cash* that repays the loan, and how well it covers each payment.
